text:
**Failure mode** — Platform / infra failure.

**Where it went wrong** — Before any Agent turn. The Run died at sandbox startup, so neither AOP Step 1 (Snowflake query) nor Step 2 (Slack post) ever executed. The AOP, Connections, and Setup were never reached.

**Evidence**
- Transcript [2]: `ERROR: sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3).`
- Context: the last 3 Runs, on different days, failed with the identical error before any Agent turn.

This is not a Connection failure, since no Snowflake or Slack call was made. It is not AOP ambiguity or missing data either: the AOP is short and clear, and the failure reproduces identically across days, independent of the data. Nothing in the AOP could have prevented it.

I did not see a Run-level confirmation of the cause of the image pull timeout (registry, network, or image size). That is for Duvo to determine.

**Fix** — None in your artifacts. Nothing in the AOP, Setup, or Connections needs to change. The sandbox environment has to be repaired on the platform side.

**Next step** — Raise this with Duvo support from the Duvo web app. I have no support-escalation tool in this session, so nothing has been reported. Include:
- Run ID `run_p01`, Build ID `bld_p01`
- The exact error: `sandbox failed to start: container image pull timed out after 120s (attempt 3/3)`
- That the last 3 Runs of this Agent, on different days, failed identically before any Agent turn
- What you ruled out: the AOP, Connections, and Setup were never reached

Once the sandbox issue is fixed, re-run the Agent. No AOP rewrite is needed, so there is no `aop-writer` handoff.
